title: A hobby worth trying
context_es: Una revista en inglés para estudiantes busca artículos de sus lectores sobre aficiones.
prompt_en:
You see this notice in an English-language magazine for students:

A hobby worth trying!
What is your hobby? How did you start? Why should other people try it?
Write an article answering these questions and we will publish the best ones.
points: say why other people should try it
useful_language: I first tried it … ago, when …
What I love most about it is that …
If you’re looking for …, give it a try!
tips_es: Un artículo necesita título y una primera frase que enganche: una pregunta funciona muy bien.
Háblale al lector: *you*, preguntas directas y un cierre que anime a probar.
Un párrafo por pregunta del anuncio.
model_answer:
Climbing without mountains

Have you ever wanted to climb but felt afraid of heights? Then indoor climbing might be the hobby for you.

I first tried it two years ago, when a friend invited me to a climbing centre. The walls are only four metres high and there are soft mats on the floor, so you can fall without getting hurt. I was terrible at first, but I enjoyed it so much that I went back the following week.

What I love most about it is that every wall is like a puzzle. You have to think before you move, and it feels fantastic when you finally reach the top. It's also a great way to meet people, because climbers always help each other.

You don't need to be strong or buy expensive equipment. If you're looking for something different, give it a try!
